suites.title: quicknotes-a-personal-single-user-mobile.spec.ts
US-0.1 – View the Note List

specs.title: navigating to `/` renders a list of all notes stored in the database
each note entry displays its `title` so the note is identifiable at a glance
pinned notes are displayed with a visible pinned indicator distinct from un-pinned notes
notes are ordered: pinned notes first (newest-first within pinned), then un-pinned notes (newest-first)
each note card/row is a tappable link that navigates to `/notes/[id]/edit`
a 'New note' button / link pointing to `/notes/new` is always visible regardless of list content

suites.title: US-0.2 – See the Empty State When No Notes Exist

specs.title: when the notes table has zero rows, the list page renders the text 'No notes yet'
the empty state includes a 'New note' button that navigates to `/notes/new`
no note cards are rendered in the empty state

suites.title: US-0.3 – Newly Created Note Appears at the Top of the List

specs.title: after a successful POST /api/notes, the browser redirects to `/`
the newly created note is visible on the list without a page refresh
if the note is not pinned, it appears first among un-pinned notes (newest-first)

suites.title: US-0.4 – Updated Note Title Reflected in the List

specs.title: after a successful PUT /api/notes/[id], the browser redirects to `/`
the note card on the list shows the new title (not the old one)

suites.title: US-0.5 – Deleted Note No Longer Appears in the List

specs.title: after a successful DELETE /api/notes/[id], the browser redirects to `/`
the deleted note's card no longer appears in the list after redirect

suites.title: US-1.1 – Filter Notes by Partial Title

specs.title: a search input is rendered at the top of the list view (`/`)
typing characters into the search input narrows the list to matching notes (case-insensitive substring match)
only notes whose title matches are shown; non-matching notes are hidden
clearing the search input (empty string) restores the full, unfiltered list

suites.title: US-1.2 – See Empty State When Search Matches Nothing

specs.title: when a non-empty search string matches zero notes, the empty state message is displayed
no note cards are rendered in this filtered empty state

suites.title: US-2.1 – Create a New Note with Title and Body

specs.title: navigating to `/notes/new` renders a blank form with the expected fields
filling title='Groceries' and body='milk, eggs' and submitting creates the note and redirects to `/`
the new 'Groceries' note is visible on the list

suites.title: US-2.2 – Create a Pinned Note

specs.title: checking the `pinned` checkbox and submitting creates a pinned note
after redirect to `/`, the new note appears in the pinned section at the top of the list
the pinned indicator is visible on the note card

suites.title: US-2.3 – Block Submission When Title Is Empty

specs.title: if the title input is empty on submit, no API call is made
an inline validation message 'Title is required' is displayed beneath the title input
the form stays on screen with all other field values intact
entering a valid title and resubmitting proceeds normally

suites.title: US-3.1 – Open a Note and See Its Current Values Pre-filled

specs.title: clicking a note card on `/` navigates to `/notes/[id]/edit`
the title input is pre-filled with the note's current `title`
the body textarea is pre-filled with the note's current `body`
the pinned checkbox is checked if `note.pinned === true`

suites.title: US-3.2 – Save an Edited Note and See the Updated Title in the List

specs.title: changing the title value and clicking 'Save' calls PUT /api/notes/[id]
on 200 response, the browser redirects to `/`
the note card on the list shows the updated title

suites.title: US-3.3 – Toggle Pinned Status on an Existing Note

specs.title: checking or unchecking the `pinned` checkbox and saving updates the pinned value
on return to `/`, the note appears in the correct section based on the new value

suites.title: US-3.4 – See Not-Found State for a Missing Note

specs.title: navigating to `/notes/[id]/edit` for a non-existent `id` renders 'Note not found.'
the form is not rendered in the not-found state
a link back to `/` is provided on the not-found page
a non-integer `id` segment in the URL also triggers the not-found state

suites.title: US-4.1 – Delete a Note with Confirmation

specs.title: a 'Delete' button is visible on `/notes/[id]/edit` alongside the Save CTA
clicking 'Delete' triggers a confirmation step before any API call is made
confirming the deletion redirects to `/`
the deleted note no longer appears in the list after redirect
cancelling the confirmation returns the form to its normal state

suites.title: US-5.1 – Retrieve All Notes via API

specs.title: GET /api/notes returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/json
the response body is a JSON array of Note objects
GET /api/notes?q=<string> returns only notes whose title contains the string (case-insensitive)

suites.title: US-5.2 – Create a Note via API

specs.title: POST /api/notes with a valid body returns 201 with the created Note object
POST /api/notes with a missing or empty `title` returns 400 with { error: 'TITLE_REQUIRED' }
POST /api/notes with malformed JSON returns 400 with { error: 'BAD_REQUEST' }

suites.title: US-5.3 – Fetch, Update, and Delete a Single Note via API

specs.title: GET /api/notes/[id] for a valid existing id returns 200 with the Note object
GET /api/notes/[id] for a non-existent id returns 404 with { error: 'NOTE_NOT_FOUND' }
PUT /api/notes/[id] with valid body returns 200 with the updated Note object
PUT /api/notes/[id] with empty title returns 400 with { error: 'TITLE_REQUIRED' }
DELETE /api/notes/[id] for an existing note returns 204 with no response body
DELETE /api/notes/[id] for a non-existent id returns 404 with { error: 'NOTE_NOT_FOUND' }

suites.title: US-6.1 – Confirm App Liveness via Health Endpoint

specs.title: GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with Content-Type: application/json
the response body is exactly {"status":"ok"}

suites.title: US-9.1 – App Renders Inside an Embedded Preview Iframe

specs.title: HTTP responses do not include an X-Frame-Options: DENY header
next.config.mjs exists at the project root; next.config.ts does not exist

suites.title: US-9.2 – App Is Reachable on Port 3000

specs.title: the app is reachable at http://localhost:3000
